'''Gengi Tung''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who served as a member of the [[shaper caste]] of the for the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire]] following its capture of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]]. Tung then oversaw the empire's efforts to [[Terraforming/Legends|terraform]] Coruscant to recreate their ancient [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Yuuzhan'tar]].

==History==
'''Gengi Tung''' was a member of the [[shaper caste]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[species]] who participated in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] between the Yuuzhan Vong and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Core Worlds" /> In [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], the Vong captured [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]&mdash;the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]&mdash; and formed the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire]]. The empire then began an effort to [[Terraforming/Legends|terraform]] Coruscant to resemble their ancient [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Yuuzhan'tar]]. During this time, Tung was [[Escalation|escalated]] to the rank of [[Master Shaper]] after [[Shimrra Jamaane]], the [[Supreme Overlord]] of the empire, had [[Death/Legends|executed]] several ranking shapers for failing to control the [[World Brain]], a [[biot|bioengineered lifeform]] created to terraform Coruscant. <ref name="Core Worlds" />

Surprised at the elevation, Tung was determined to live up to the rank. When survivors from the battle began sabotage attacks on the empire's operations on Coruscant, Tung began to accompan [[Warrior caste|warriors]] into the field as they sought out the offenders. One of his goals was to capture one of the saboteurs alive and use [[brainwashing]] to force them to [[Treason/Legends|betray]] the rest.<ref name="Core Worlds" />

==Personality and traits==
Tung was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] Yuuzhan Vong who had replaced his [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] with needle-sharp [[Quill/Legends|quills]].<ref name="Core Worlds" />

==Skills and abilities==
Tung was skilled with organic [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapons]] including the [[tsaisi]] and the [[amphistaff]]. He understood how to craft various Yong biotechnology including control organisms, prosthetic organisms, space transport organism, starfighter organisms, and weapon organisms. Tung was diplomatic with an ability to bluff, appraise, and sense a being's motive. He also knew how to treat injuries and handle a variety of animals.<ref name="Core Worlds" />

==Equipment==
Tung wore a tentacled headdress the color of dried blood along with various pieces of biotechnology such as an [[ooglith masquer]]&mdash;which allowed him to disquies himself&mdash;two [[villip]]s, and a [[tizowyrm]]&mdash;which allowed him to understand and speak a variety of languages. He carried a tsaisi, a type of organic melee weapon, and was accompanied by [[Toi]] and [[Tixo]], his two pet [[umrach]]s.<ref name="Core Worlds" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gengi Tung was first mentioned in the ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', a sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] in [[2003]].<ref name="Core Worlds" />
